skill.description: Automate DocuSign template discovery, envelope creation, signature sending, status tracking, and document management through Rube MCP.

security_audit.summary: The external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around DocuSign and Rube MCP tool names. The only confirmed issue is a disclosed third-party MCP endpoint, which is a low network trust-boundary risk.

remediation.suggestion: Tell users that Rube MCP and DocuSign may receive document metadata and signer details before they connect the endpoint.

static_findings.snippet: - Active DocuSign connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `docusign`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- Response includes template `templateId`, `name`, `description`, roles, and fields
- `emailSubject`: Custom subject line for the signing email
- `emailBlurb`: Custom message in the signing email
- `templateRoles` must match the role names defined in the template exactly (case-sensitive)
- Setting `status` to 'sent' during creation sends immediately; use 'created' for drafts
- Each role requires at minimum `roleName`, `name`, and `email`
- `emailSubject` overrides the template's default email subject
1. `DOCUSIGN_GET_ENVELOPE` - Verify envelope exists and is in draft state [Prerequisite]
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- All required recipients must have valid email addresses before sending

content.value_statement: DocuSign work requires careful template, recipient, and envelope status handling. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup for Rube MCP and a DocuSign OAuth connection.
Lists and inspects DocuSign templates before envelope creation.
Maps template roles to signer names and email addresses.
Creates and sends envelopes from DocuSign templates.
Checks envelope and recipient status during signing.
Adds templates to draft envelopes when DocuSign allows it.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active DocuSign connection.
Depends on current DocuSign tool schemas from Rube search.
Does not provide legal advice or contract review.
Cannot change sent envelopes beyond supported DocuSign actions.

use_cases.title: Send Contract Templates
use_cases.description: Prepare a contract envelope from a DocuSign template and assign each signer role correctly.

use_cases.title: Track Signature Progress
use_cases.description: Check envelope and recipient status to see who has received, signed, or declined a document.

use_cases.title: Manage Onboarding Paperwork
use_cases.description: Use saved templates to send hiring, policy, or benefits forms to new employees.

prompt_templates.title: Find Available Templates
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the docusign-automation skill to list available DocuSign templates. Show template names, roles, and any useful descriptions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Draft Envelope
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the docusign-automation skill to create a draft envelope from the named template. Map each role to these recipients and do not send yet.

prompt_templates.title: Send and Confirm an Envelope
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the docusign-automation skill to verify this draft envelope is ready, send it for signing, and report the resulting envelope status.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Signing Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the docusign-automation skill to review these envelope IDs, compare recipient progress, and summarize blockers or completed signatures.

output_examples.input: Find the mutual NDA template and prepare it for two signers.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the matching template, reviews required roles, assigns both signers, and creates a draft envelope for review.

output_examples.input: Send the approved sales agreement envelope.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks that the envelope is still a draft, confirms required recipients, sends it, and reports the new sent status.

output_examples.input: Check whether the onboarding documents were completed.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves envelope status, lists each recipient state, and notes whether the envelope is completed or still waiting.

best_practices: Search current Rube tool schemas before calling DocuSign tools.
Create drafts first when signer details or email content need review.
Poll envelope status at reasonable intervals to respect rate limits.
anti_patterns: Do not send envelopes before confirming recipients and template roles.
Do not hardcode template or envelope identifiers across DocuSign accounts.
Do not treat delivered status as proof that a document was signed.

faq.question: Does this skill require DocuSign access?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a DocuSign connection through Rube MCP before workflows can run.

faq.question: Can it create envelopes from templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides template selection, role mapping, draft creation, and sending.

faq.question: Can it check who has signed?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve envelope and recipient status through DocuSign tools.

faq.question: Can it edit an envelope after sending?
faq.answer: Only DocuSign-supported lifecycle actions are available. Sent envelopes cannot be treated like drafts.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It automates workflow steps and does not review legal meaning or compliance.

faq.question: Why does it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change, so searching first helps use current parameter names and capabilities.
